fields.account:
Show who's here on mobile via a slide-in drawer

The mobile media query hid #who-panel entirely, so phone users had no
way to see channel members. Add a "here" button to the chat header that
toggles the existing panel as a right-edge drawer on mobile; desktop
keeps the always-visible sidebar. Escape closes the drawer.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01Kvg7m5hacw7tYqUVSv52R6

---

Add e2e screenshots for the mobile who drawer

Captures the new "N here" header button in its resting state and the
slide-in drawer fully open, at the phone viewport, so the new UI can be
eyeballed alongside the rest of the screenshot set.

https://claude.ai/code/session_01Kvg7m5hacw7tYqUVSv52R6

ended.reason: merged into main as 3ebd17d, "Merge pull request #16 … Add mobile who-panel drawer with toggle button"

fields.answer: On mobile, #who-panel becomes a right-edge slide-in drawer inside .chat-body, toggled by an "N here" header button (#who-toggle, min-height 44px, aria-expanded); Escape closes it. Desktop keeps the always-visible sidebar.
fields.why: The mobile media query hid #who-panel entirely, so phone users had no way to see channel members.

fields.what: Eyeball the mobile who-drawer screenshots: 10-chat-mobile-who-closed.png (resting "N here" button) and 11-chat-mobile-who-open.png (drawer fully open), 390x844 dark.
fields.why-person: so the new UI can be eyeballed alongside the rest of the screenshot set
fields.how: Run test/e2e/screenshots.spec.ts, test "screenshot: mobile who-drawer (closed and open)"; open the two PNGs in SHOT_DIR. No images are committed.
